---
title: "Your Paper Title Here"
short-title: "Short Title"
date: today
author:
  - name: Your Name
    email: your.email@university.edu
    url: https://yourwebsite.com
    orcid: 0000-0000-0000-0000
    affiliations:
      - name: Your University
        department: Department of Your Field
        attributes:
          corresponding: true
  # Uncomment below to add co-authors:
  # - name: Co-Author Name
  #   email: coauthor@university.edu
  #   affiliations:
  #     - name: Their University
  #       department: Their Department
abstract: |
  Write your abstract here. This should be a concise summary of your paper,
  typically 150--250 words. It should state the research question, data,
  methods, key findings, and contribution.
thanks: |
  I thank [acknowledgments here]. All errors are my own.
keywords:
  - keyword1
  - keyword2
  - keyword3
bibliography: references.bib
format:
  # ── PDF (working paper style) ──────────────────────────────
  # Requires the hikmah extension (included in _extensions/)
  # Render: quarto render working-paper.qmd --to hikmah-pdf
  hikmah-pdf:
    toc: false
    number-sections: true
    keep-tex: true
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{threeparttable}
        \usepackage{threeparttablex}
        \usepackage{longtable}
        \usepackage{booktabs}
  # ── HTML (self-contained) ──────────────────────────────────
  # Render: quarto render working-paper.qmd --to html
  html:
    toc: true
    number-sections: true
    self-contained: true
  # ── Word (docx) ───────────────────────────────────────────
  # Render: quarto render working-paper.qmd --to docx
  docx:
    toc: true
    number-sections: true
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    echo: false
    message: false
    warning: false
---
